name: Precision Analytical Console
designThesis: High-signal, cognitive-ergonomic telemetry and operations interface. Employs tabular numeric alignment, scannable data density, micro-sparklines, and zero decorative fluff to minimize cognitive load under time-critical operational conditions.
bestFitContexts: Industrial telemetry and IoT telemetry monitors

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Deep technical slate-black (#090d16) in dark mode; clinical ice-neutral (#f1f5f9) in light mode
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Strict intent-based palette: emerald green for nominal/healthy, amber for warning/degraded, crimson for critical/failure, cyan for active selection
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA on metrics and code values; 5.0:1 on status badges

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Technical monospaced data font (JetBrains Mono / Fira Code) with condensed grotesque sans (Geist / IBM Plex Sans)
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Metrics emphasized by numeral weight and size, accompanied by muted micro-labels; tabular lining figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) mandatory
typographyStrategy.scaleFactor: 1.125 (Major Second) tight scale for maximum information compactness without visual clutter

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: 16-column dense data grid with 8px gutters; collapsible telemetry rails and fixed-height scrollable log streams
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Calibrated tight spacing (4px–8px padding inside data cells, 16px between macro widgets)

surfaceTreatment.radius: 0px to 2px sharp precision edges; absolutely no pill-shaped buttons in data tables
surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px technical hairline grid borders using var(--ot-border-subtle)
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Flat planar surfaces with 1px border separation; zero drop shadows to maintain razor-sharp pixel boundary alignment

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Compact rectangular buttons with mono hotkey indicators (e.g., [⌘K], [R]) and tactile pressed state
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Self-contained metric cards with inline SVG sparklines, status pills, and delta indicators
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Dense data grid with sticky headers, column sorting indicators, hover crosshairs, and monospaced alignment

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Full vim-style or arrow-key cell navigation; [Esc] to dismiss modals/drawers; screen reader aria-live regions for streaming alerts
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Streaming chart updates render via requestAnimationFrame without spring transitions when reduced-motion is detected

antiPatterns: Floating bubbly card layouts with 16px border-radius
Soft colorful drop shadows under metric numbers
Proportional non-tabular numbers that cause table layout jitter
Unlabeled icon-only status indicators without text or tooltip

browserChecks: Verify tabular-nums alignment across streaming numeric updates
Verify zero layout shift during asynchronous data polling
Verify keyboard-only table row selection and filtering
